top_choice_rationale: The magic-wavelength optical lattice is an identifiable original invention, separable from the 2005 comb and 2012 single-ion prizes, and it was realised and verified experimentally, with 1e-18-level uncertainties reproduced independently at several laboratories. Katori proposed and realised it and Ye brought it to record accuracy; no decisive third contribution has been shown. The citation must name the lattice and invention and realisation, and must not imply a discovery about constants. No award is a weaker outcome than a mature, verified, original achievement.
